gbm_population_evidence.quote: Brain Cancer; Malignant Brain Tumor; Recurrent Brain Tumor; Progressive Malignant Brain Tumor; Brain Tumor, Pediatric; Brain Tumor Adult
Diagnosis of recurrent or progressive malignant primary brain tumor (WHO grade III or IV), including recurrent ependymoma (WHO grade II and III).

gbm_population_flag.reason: Recurrent malignant primary brain tumours WHO grade III/IV are eligible (would include glioblastoma), but glioblastoma is never named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels; only 'high-grade glioma' in the summary.

candidate_evidence.quote: Each participant will receive magrolimab intravenously (IV) at a priming dose of 1 mg/kg during Cycle 0, followed by either 30 mg/kg or 45mg mg/kg dose weekly for eight weeks (Cycles 1 and 2)
Anti-cancer therapeutic agent targeting the CD47-signal receptor protein-alpha (SIRP-alpha) axis

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Magrolimab in Children and Adults With Recurrent or Progressive Malignant Brain Tumors

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To evaluate the pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of magrolimab in blood and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) in children and adults with recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumors.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To evaluate Ferumoxytol MRI imaging as a biomarker for intratumoral macrophages during treatment with magrolimab in children and adults with recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumors.
To evaluate the changes in the immune cells in the peripheral blood and CSF and changes in the immune cytokine milieu in the peripheral blood serum and CSF during treatment with magrolimab

role_evidence.quote: Magrolimab in Children and Adults With Recurrent or Progressive Malignant Brain Tumors

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Binding of magrolimab to human CD47 on target malignant cells blocks the "don't eat me" signal to macrophages and enhances tumor cell phagocytosis.

source_quote.quote: To evaluate Ferumoxytol MRI imaging as a biomarker for intratumoral macrophages during treatment with magrolimab in children and adults with recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumors.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: cell-free tumour DNA in blood and CSF

source_quote.quote: To evaluate the changes in the amounts of cell-free tumor DNA in the peripheral blood and CSF during treatment with magrolimab in children and adults with recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumors.

coder_notes: Mixed paediatric/adult (Stratum A children, Stratum B adults) trial in recurrent malignant primary brain tumours WHO grade III/IV; glioblastoma not named in conditions/title/inclusion, so coded high_grade_glioma_unspecified (exclude as not_glioblastoma), flagged uncertain. Ferumoxytol MRI is an exploratory imaging biomarker but ferumoxytol is not a registered intervention and the record does not state every patient receives it, so it is not listed as an agent (R9). CSF PK planned (tumour_pk yes). Immune cell/cytokine changes in blood and CSF also planned as pharmacodynamic readouts.
